name: wttr.in
description_en: :partly_sunny: The right way to check the weather
readme_excerpt: wttr.in — the right way to ~check~ curl the weather! wttr.in is a console-oriented weather forecast service that supports various information representation methods like terminal-oriented ANSI-sequences for console HTTP clients (curl, httpie, or wget), HTML for web browsers, or PNG for graphical viewers.
